lines.text: My front door camera goes off every night. At exactly three twelve.
Every morning, I check the clip. And the porch is always empty.
Then I noticed something. The clips don't start on the porch.
They start with my front door opening.
Someone had been walking out of my house every night. And coming back in before I woke up.
So last night, I stayed up and watched the live feed.
Three eleven. Three twelve. My phone buzzed.
But it wasn't the camera. It was my smart lock.
Whoever had been leaving every night didn't leave tonight.
They locked the door. Not to keep anyone out.
